footer.tagline: A sandbox digital wallet: send money to saved beneficiaries, set budgets and savings goals, in English or Urdu. Built as a portfolio project; all money is simulated.
footer.disclaimer: Pennywise is a demonstration project. It is not a bank or a licensed payment service, and it never moves real money.

about.title: About Pennywise
about.lead: Pennywise is a portfolio project: a working digital-wallet web app built to show how money features can be made safe, clear and accessible.

sandbox.title: Sandbox notice
sandbox.body: Everything here uses simulated money. New accounts start with a Rs. 50,000 welcome balance that has no real value. Pennywise is not a bank, is not licensed by any regulator, and cannot send or receive real payments. Please do not enter real bank or card details.

security.title: How it is secured
security.pin: Transaction PIN: a 6-digit PIN, stored only as a salted hash and checked on the server. Five wrong tries lock it for 15 minutes.
security.mfa: Two-step verification: transfers of Rs. 10,000 or more need a fresh code from your authenticator app. The server checks it in your signed session, not in the browser.
security.limits: Limits: Rs. 50,000 per transfer and Rs. 100,000 per day (Pakistan time).
security.isolation: Data isolation: database row-level security means each account can only read its own records. Balances cannot be edited from the browser; money moves only through audited database functions.
security.idempotency: Safe retries: every transfer carries a unique request key, so a repeated tap or a flaky connection cannot charge you twice.
security.session: Sessions end automatically after 15 minutes of inactivity.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.body: We store your email, name, the beneficiaries you add, and your simulated transactions. Nothing is sold or shared. To have your account deleted, contact the project owner.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.body: Pennywise is built for keyboard and screen-reader use: a skip link, labelled form fields, visible focus, announcements for step changes and errors, text alternatives for charts, and sufficient colour contrast. The interface works in English and in Urdu (right-to-left). Automated checks run on every change; manual testing with screen readers is ongoing, so please tell us about anything that gets in your way.

stack.title: Built with
stack.body: React, TypeScript and Vite on the front end; Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, row-level security) on the back end; installable as a PWA.

home.heroSub: A digital wallet where every transfer is confirmed with your PIN, large ones with an authenticator code, and nothing is charged twice. English and Urdu.

step1.title: Create your wallet
step1.desc: Sign up and get a Rs. 50,000 sandbox balance. No real money, no bank details.

step2.title: Save a beneficiary
step2.desc: Add a name, bank and IBAN. Pennywise checks the IBAN's check digits so typos are caught early.

step3.title: Send with confidence
step3.desc: Confirm with your PIN (plus an authenticator code from Rs. 10,000). You get a receipt with a reference number.

f1.title: Protected transfers
f1.desc: Server-checked PIN, two-step verification, daily limits and safe retries.

f2.title: Real insights
f2.desc: Monthly income, spending, balance and categories calculated from your own transactions.

f3.title: Savings goals
f3.desc: Move money between your wallet and a goal, and see progress at a glance.

f4.title: English and Urdu
f4.desc: A full right-to-left Urdu interface, with numbers and IBANs kept readable.

f5.title: Accessible by design
f5.desc: Keyboard friendly, screen-reader aware, with chart data available as tables.

f6.title: Installable
f6.desc: Add it to your phone's home screen like an app.
